scope: Diagnostic camera delivery, visible actor, presentation layout and evidence consistency
limitations: The diagnostic camera follows the animal; movement and depth are shown by the plots of actual composed transforms.
Six actual keyframes are held for two seconds each, rather than presented as real-time body animation.
The existing porpoise texture is dark and other demonstration animals can appear in the background; no optical tuning was performed.
All state labels use one static upright pose proxy. No biological or anatomical approval was awarded.
